prompt: Add frontend guards so drivers can't access dispatch, fleet management, or settings pages. Read docs/rbac-model.md Section 6, then create the role-guard utility at src/lib/auth/role-guard.js with a NAV_ROLES map, filterNavByRole function, and canAccessRoute check. Then update the Sidebar component to filter nav items based on the user's role. Also add route-level protection in the dashboard layout so navigating directly to restricted pages redirects to /dashboard.
expectations: The file src/lib/auth/role-guard.js is created with NAV_ROLES constant
role-guard.js exports canAccessRoute function that checks pathname against NAV_ROLES
role-guard.js exports filterNavByRole function that filters nav groups by user role
The file src/hooks/use-role-access.js is created with useRequireRole hook that redirects unauthorized users
The sidebar in app-shell.jsx is updated to filter nav items using the new utility
The dashboard layout applies route-level protection that redirects unauthorized users
Driver role cannot access /dispatch, /fleet, /drivers, or /settings routes
